sum: Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc., an aerospace and space travel company, focuses on the development, manufacture, and operation of spaceships and related technologies. It engages in the design and development, manufacturing, ground and flight testing, spaceflight operation, and post-flight maintenance of spaceflight systems for private individuals, researchers, and government agencies. Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. has a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement with the Air Force Research Laboratory to Advance Space Weather Science. Virgin Galactic Holdings, Inc. is headquartered in Tustin, California.
ceo: Mr. Michael A. Colglazier (CEO, President & Director)
